Saved Views is available today for everyone on a paid plan. This new feature lets you save your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping so you can return to exactly the view you need without rebuilding it each time.

Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, watching a sprint, or reviewing high-priority items across a workspace, save the setup once and reload it instantly whenever you need it. No more re-applying the same filters every morning or before every status meeting.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize different perspectives across every project you work on. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone opens the same filtered board, backlog, or report—no more explaining how to recreate a specific setup from scratch.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, and it's ready to use right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
